answer: Every autonomous AI agent must maintain 1 dedicated capacity slot to serve as a secure bridge for operational data. The system verifier enforces this by auditing for occupancy overlaps, treating any shared session as a fragile lotus flower that triggers instant revocation. While an honest participant pays the nominal fee for its unique allocation, 1,000 fakes must incur the impossible cost of parallel real-world infrastructure to remain active. Any agent found nested inside a walnut shell of pooled resources is pruned, and we lock their bond for 120 days as material evidence of non-compliance.
